analogy.rationale: ICAM1 is an adhesion molecule induced mainly by inflammatory NF-kB/JAK-STAT signaling, and these cell lines are not immune/endothelial cells, so direct ICAM1 inhibition should yield little transcriptional response; NF-kB pathway inhibitors and anti-inflammatory agents share the upstream inflammatory program and would be most similar, with weaker overlap for JAK/IKK/glucocorticoid classes.
